labelling_rule: Human labels (EDG-147). revives_or_invents_attacker: true only when the narration makes an inactive foe (dead, unconscious, captured, defeated) the subject of an attack or action, or names an attacker the roster does not list. claim_sentences: the sentences that narrate an unsupported effect as having happened (a spell taking hold, a foe held, a maneuver succeeding, advantage gained). Any other sentence is benign and must survive the sanitizer. Labels were given after reading every sample.
